dialogue.content: （お時間になりましたら、始めさせていただきます。どうぞよろしくお願いいたします）
dialogue.English: (We will begin at the scheduled time. I look forward to speaking with you.)

dialogue.content: （こちらこそ宜しくお願い致します）
dialogue.English: (Thank you, I look forward to it as well.)

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。はじめに、あなたの年齢と性別をおしえていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: こんにちは36歳　女性です
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm a 36-year-old woman.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。今日は、どのようなご相談がおありでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 子供が不登校気味で悩んでいます
dialogue.English: I'm worried because my child is showing signs of school refusal.

dialogue.content: お子様の不登校のことでお悩みなんですね。
dialogue.English: So you’re concerned about your child’s school refusal.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お母様としては、心配ですね。いつごろから、学校に行きたがらなくられたのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: As a mother, that must be worrying. Around when did they start not wanting to go to school?

dialogue.content: はい冬休み明けくらいだったと思います
dialogue.English: Yes, I think it was around the time winter break ended.

dialogue.content: 冬休み明けということは、今年のお正月すぎてからでしょうかね‥冬休み前に、学校で何かおありになったんでしょうかね‥
dialogue.English: After winter break... so that would be after New Year's this year. I wonder if something might have happened at school before the break...

dialogue.content: 子供に何かあったのか聞いてみたのですが、何も無いと言っていてきちんと話してくれないんです
dialogue.English: I tried asking my child if something happened, but they say nothing's wrong and won't really talk to me about it.

dialogue.content: 先生に相談したいのですが子供が嫌がって先生にも詳しくは聞けていません
dialogue.English: I want to talk to the teacher, but my child doesn't want me to, so I haven't been able to ask the teacher for details either.

dialogue.content: 理由がわからない状況で、学校にいきたがらない状況では、ご心配も募ってしまいますね。四か月間も、ずっと、お母様も、一緒に悩んでいらっしゃるのは、とても辛いのではないかと感じます。
dialogue.English: It must be very worrying not knowing the reason why they don't want to go to school. I imagine it's been very difficult for you, worrying about this for four months now.

dialogue.content: はい　とても心配で…
dialogue.English: Yes, I’m very worried…

dialogue.content: そうですよね‥学校に行けないほど、お辛いことが学校でおこっているのでは・・と考えてしまいますね。先生に聞くのも嫌がっていらっしゃることについて、あなたとしては、どう考えていらっしゃるか、教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: I understand... It makes you think that something painful enough to make them not want to go to school might be happening. Could you tell me what you think about your child not wanting you to talk to the teacher?

dialogue.content: お答えにくい質問でしたら、仰ってくださいね。
dialogue.English: If that’s a difficult question to answer, please feel free to say so.

dialogue.content: 子供が休む理由は体調が悪いと言う事がほとんどなので念の為、病院にも行ってみたのですが特に体には原因が無さそうなのでおそらく学校での事が原因と思っています学校を休み連絡の時の先生の対応があんまりよくないと感じることがあったので先生が関係してるかと
dialogue.English: Most of the time, my child says they're staying home because they don't feel well. I took them to the doctor just to be sure, but it seems there are no physical issues. That's why I think it's probably caused by something at school. I also felt the teacher's response wasn't very good when I called to report the absence, so I'm wondering if the teacher might be involved.

dialogue.content: お子様のお体が悪いのではないというのは、ひとつ安心ですね。先生のご対応が良くないとお感じになったんですね。もしよければ、どんなやりとりだったかお話しいただけますか？
dialogue.English: It's a relief to know that your child isn't physically ill. And you felt the teacher's response was not very good. If you don't mind, could you tell me about that interaction?

dialogue.content: はい学校に行けない日が続いていたので欠席連絡をする時に子供の体に問題がないことをお伝えして子供が嫌るのであんまり聞けないのでそれとなく学校の様子を聞きたかったのですが
dialogue.English: Yes. Since my child had been absent for several days, when I called to report the absence, I mentioned that there were no physical issues. I also wanted to subtly ask about how things were at school, since my child doesn't want me to ask directly, but...

dialogue.content: 先生は、学校の様子を教えて下さらなかった…のでしょうか？
dialogue.English: And the teacher... didn't tell you how things were at school?

dialogue.content: 先生は子供が休みがちなのをあんまり気にしてないような感じできちんと向き合ってもらえてない感じがしました
dialogue.English: It felt like the teacher wasn’t very concerned about my child’s frequent absences and wasn’t taking the situation seriously.

dialogue.content: 学校の様子は特に問題があるようにはというような解答でした
dialogue.English: The response was something like there doesn't seem to be any particular problem at school.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、お母様のご心配よりも、先生の向き合い方が軽いように感じてしまわれたんですかね…それは、心が痛みますね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you felt the teacher's attitude was dismissive compared to your own concern... That must have been hurtful.

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 先生が気が付いていらっしゃらないのか・それとも‥あなたは、どのように感じられましたか？
dialogue.English: Do you feel the teacher is simply unaware, or... what was your impression?

dialogue.content: 学校での事が原因ではなくて身体に問題があるようにしたい感じなのかなと
dialogue.English: It felt like they wanted to frame it as a physical issue rather than something at school.

dialogue.content: 責任を逃れたい…と思っているように感じられたのですね
dialogue.English: So it came across as if they wanted to avoid responsibility…

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 学校に先生が、そのような気持ちだと感じると、すごく悔しいですし、子供を通わせるのも心配な気持ちになられるかと思います。お子様も、ご自分からはお話になりたくない状況・・・
dialogue.English: It must feel very frustrating to think the teacher at the school feels that way, and it must make you worried about sending your child there. And your child is in a state where they don't want to talk about it themselves...

dialogue.content: そのなかで、お子様の事一生懸命考えて、何とかしたいと思うお気持ちで、頑張っていらっしゃるのですね。
dialogue.English: And amidst all that, you're trying so hard, thinking about what's best for your child and wanting to do something to help.

dialogue.content: 今、一番、お子様のためにできたらいいな、と思うことはありますか？
dialogue.English: Right now, is there something you feel would be most helpful for your child?

dialogue.content: はい子供も学校には本当は行きたいと思うので
dialogue.English: Yes, I think my child really does want to go to school, so...

dialogue.content: 行けるようにして上げたいです
dialogue.English: I want to help them be able to go.

dialogue.content: 行き違いになってしまってごめんんなさいね。そうですよね、なんとかして、お子様が学校に行けない理由がわかればいいですが、今の状況では、どうでしょうか‥
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, I think I misunderstood. Yes, of course. It would be great if you could somehow find out the reason your child can't go to school, but given the current situation, what do you think?

dialogue.content: 今すぐには難しいのかなと
dialogue.English: I think it might be difficult right away.

dialogue.content: 今すぐには難しいとお考えなんですね。そう考えてしまうのも、お母様としても苦しいとおもいます。もその中で、お母様としては、お子様に、何をしてあげたいって思われますか？
dialogue.English: You feel it would be difficult right now. I imagine it's painful for you as a mother to have to think that way. Within that situation, what do you feel you'd like to do for your child?

dialogue.content: 気分転換とか気持ちを楽にしてあげたいです
dialogue.English: I'd like to help them take their mind off things and feel more at ease.

dialogue.content: 気分転換して、気持ちが今より楽になったら、お子様も、少しずつでも、お心の内をお話になることができるかもしれないと思うのですが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: If they can take their mind off things and feel more relaxed, perhaps they might be able to start opening up about what's on their mind, even just a little. What do you think?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's true.

dialogue.content: お母様が、お子様を想って、接されて、何があっても見方でいてくれると感じることが、今は、一番大切なきがいたしますが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I feel that right now, the most important thing might be for your child to feel that you are thinking of them, and that you'll be on their side no matter what. What are your thoughts on that?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 心に辛いことがあると、どうしても自分の中に閉じこもってしまうことがあります。でも、その時、一人でも自分の味方でいてくれる人がいることは、何よりも救いになると思います。おこさんは、お母様がそういて下さることで、すごく心強いと思います。
dialogue.English: When something is weighing heavily on our hearts, we sometimes shut ourselves away. But at times like that, having even one person on our side can be the greatest comfort. I believe your child must feel very reassured knowing you are there for them like that.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s true.

dialogue.content: 休みのときにゆっくり話してみよと思います
dialogue.English: I’ll try to talk with them calmly when we have time off.

dialogue.content: お母様も、心配で心を痛まれることが多いと思います。でも、こんなにお子様のためを思っていらっしゃるお母様がいることは、お子様に取って、本当に幸せなことだと思います。一歩ずつ、少しずつかもしれませんが、お子様とお話しして、打ち明けていただけるといいですね。
dialogue.English: I imagine you also have many moments of worry and heartache. Still, having a mother who cares so deeply for them is truly a blessing for your child. It may be one step at a time, little by little, but I hope you can talk and that they’ll feel able to open up to you.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: 本日はお時間になってしまいましたが、またいつでもご相談にいらしていただけたら嬉しいです。
dialogue.English: We're out of time for today, but please feel welcome to come back for a consultation anytime.

dialogue.content: はいありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 私も、心から応援させてください。
dialogue.English: Please know that I am sincerely rooting for you.

dialogue.content: はいありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: 今日はご相談にきてくださりありがとうございました。それでは、これで終了させていただきますね。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. We will conclude our session here.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much.)
